entry.text: FINANALYTIC CAPITAL PVT. LTD. Assistant Data Lead Mumbai, India Aug 2018 - Oct 2021
Key Achievements:
Led 10-member Data Science team delivering analytics solutions, ML models, and ETL pipelines
Built end-to-end Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks workflows for financial performance analytics and automated reporting
Implemented ML models (scikit-learn: RandomForest, Logistic Regression, IsolationForest) to detect financial anomalies, predict revenue trends, and identify outlier transactions
Reduced manual reporting work by 120+ hours per month through automation and cloud-scale transformation pipelines
Designed interactive Power BI dashboards with predictive KPIs and early-warning indicators for leadership
Key Responsibilities:
Collaborated with business and finance stakeholders to define KPIs, capture analytical requirements, and translate them into measurable data products and ML use cases.

Applied ML techniques—Random Forests, Logistic Regression, Gradient Boosting, and K-Means clustering—to enhance forecasting accuracy and detect anomalies across spending, revenue, cash flow, and investment KPIs.
Implemented predictive models for churn, sales forecasting, budget variance prediction, and cost trend analysis using structured, time-series, and semi-structured datasets.
Developed transformation notebooks in Azure Databricks (PySpark) to cleanse, aggregate, and enrich financial datasets for reporting and ML models
Applied ML techniques (RandomForest, Logistic Regression, K-Means clustering) to improve forecasting accuracy and detect anomalies in spending, revenue, and investment metrics
Led Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder demos, ensuring smooth delivery cycles
Published curated datasets and ML outputs to SQL/ADF pipelines for consumption in Power BI dashboards
FINANALYTIC CAPITAL Senior Software Engineer - Analytics Delhi, India
